explanation.headline: Pegfilgrastim is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 14.6 days on hand and Corvale General has 27.4 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's records show pegfilgrastim is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 41 syringes at 2.8 per day, giving 14.6 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 157 syringes at 5.7 per day, giving 27.4 days on hand.
A label for pegfilgrastim names Kashiv BioSciences, LLC as the plant (FEI 3011289655) with operations including manufacture.
FDA inspected that plant on 2024-06-14 and classified it VAI, with the classification known on 2024-08-16.
The same plant received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2018-01-26, known on 2018-02-16.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Accord BioPharma, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
